name: CHIP children's health coverage
valueBasis: Low-cost health coverage for children. Not a payment, so no dollar figure is estimated.

criteria.instructions: Does the household include a child under 19?
Is any child in the household without health coverage? CHIP is for children who are not already covered.
criteria.askIfUnsure: Are your children without health insurance?
criteria.assumption: the children are not already covered by other insurance
